verdict.rationale: Auth0's log streaming service exports tenant logs (including auth events like sign-ups/sign-ins) 'in near real-time' to external log analysis services, which partially satisfies the event-streaming need for keeping systems in sync, but the evidence describes destinations as log-analysis services rather than generic webhook endpoints or a dedicated event/webhook subscription API for specific auth events like user changes. Missing for 10: explicit webhook subscription mechanism, granular event-type filtering (sign-up vs sign-in vs profile update), and independent/hands-on confirmation of real-time sync use cases.
